verdicts.reason: Both break apart the striped-panel concept. The stripes shrink to stubby bars, a grey bar floats with no purpose, and the product list is bigger and heavier than the $49.99 price, so the hierarchy is wrong. A also splits 'WINE GLASSES' into two lines, so the list reads as six items with 'WINE' left on its own, and it squeezes the URL into an unreadable vertical sliver between the stripes. B keeps the list intact, but its URL is a tiny, unreadable rotated scrap stuck in the top-right corner. B is a little less broken.
